name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds With Ginger and Orange Zest

instructions.primary_message: Carefully wash pumpkin seeds to remove all excess pulp. Transfer pumpkin seeds to a paper towel–lined rimmed baking sheet. Allow to rest at room temperature until completely dry, about 1 hour. To speed up the process, dry pumpkin seeds in a 90°C (200°F) oven, stirring occasionally, or use a hair dryer.
In a large bowl, combine olive oil with grated ginger and orange zest. Set aside.

Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 160°C (325°F). Toss dried pumpkin seeds with ginger-orange oil and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. Roast until pale golden brown, stirring occasionally, about 25 minutes total.
When seeds have cooled, transfer to a serving bowl, toss with minced chives, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: easy, fall, gluten free, snack, squash

description: Add fresh ginger and orange zest to roasted pumpkin seeds for a spicy, bright departure from the usual.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 45 min.

Make-ahead and storage: Roasted pumpkin seeds do not require refrigeration. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
